description.narrative:
I. The overall development objective of the project is to support the socio-economic growth and development of Benin through the achievement of universal access to electricity service in the country and more specifically in the targeted project areas, to improve the living conditions of the population and reducing poverty, which will help Benin towards achieving the SDGs 7, 8, 9 and 11.
II. This project aims at: (i) mobilizing and enhancing the national energy potential and securing the country’s electricity power generation by implementing the new PV Solar Power Plant of 7.5 MWp in Maria Gléta-2, (ii) opening-up the border areas through extension of networks and electrification by increasing the coverage of the electricity distribution network (MV & LV lines) and the public lighting in the border communes in the targeted areas, (iii) improving the efficiency of energy use by increasing the electricity connections for the benefit of households and socio-economic points to meet the increasing demand: and (iv) strengthening the operational capacities of the Executing Agency.
